description: Source code for GPIO driver for Texas Instruments CC32xx series in Zephyr RTOS, including configuration, control, and interrupt handling functions.

methods.name: gpio_cc32xx_config
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin with specified flags, setting direction and mode.

methods.name: gpio_cc32xx_port_get_raw
methods.description: Reads the raw input value of the GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_cc32xx_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets multiple GPIO pins on the port based on mask and value.

methods.name: gpio_cc32xx_port_set_bits_raw
methods.description: Sets specific GPIO pins high based on mask.

methods.name: gpio_cc32xx_port_clear_bits_raw
methods.description: Clears specific GPIO pins (sets low) based on mask.

methods.name: gpio_cc32xx_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt mode and trigger for a GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_cc32xx_manage_callback
methods.description: Manages callback registration for GPIO interrupts.

methods.name: gpio_cc32xx_port_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for GPIO port, calls registered callbacks.
